name: FineWeb-Edu
description: An educational-quality-filtered subset of the FineWeb web-text corpus, created to support language-model pretraining and evaluation focused on educational content. This record does not distribute corpus data.
citation: Penedo, G., Malartic, Q., Hesslow, D., Cojocaru, R., Cappelli, A., et al. (2024). The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale. arXiv:2406.17557. https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.17557

license.notes: FineWeb-Edu is derived from web-crawled source material and does not have a single standard SPDX license. Review the upstream dataset access conditions and the rights applicable to underlying source content before use or redistribution.
